# 1 Clement Chapter 57 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 57 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_057_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 57

**57:1** So then — you who started this rebellion — submit yourselves to the presbyters. Accept the correction being offered and let it lead you to repentance. Bend the knees of your heart.

**57:2** Learn what it means to live under authority. Put down the proud, arrogant boasting that has come from your lips. It is far better to be humble and honored within the flock of Christ than to be prominent in reputation and cast away from his hope.

**57:3** This is what all-excellent Wisdom says: "Listen! I am going to tell you what my spirit is saying; I am going to teach you my word.

**57:4** I called and you would not listen. I stretched out my hands and you paid no attention. You dismissed my counsel and ignored my correction.

**57:5** So when ruin comes for you, I will laugh. When disaster falls on you, when sudden panic overtakes you, when catastrophe hits you like a storm, when you are crushed by distress and anguish — I will rejoice.

**57:6** You will call on me then, but I will not answer. The wicked will look for me and not find me. Why? Because they hated wisdom and rejected the fear of the LORD.

**57:7** They would not listen to my counsel, and they treated my correction as a joke.

**57:8** So they will eat the fruit of their own choices and be stuffed full of their own godlessness.

**57:9** Because they abused the innocent, they will be killed; and God's judgment will destroy the wicked.

**57:10** But whoever listens to me will live in confidence, resting in hope, with nothing to fear."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
